metaDescription: CPT 99427 explained: the PCM add-on for each extra 30 minutes of clinical staff time. Monthly limit, documentation and the 2026 national rate.
summary: An add-on reported with 99426 for each additional 30 minutes of clinical staff time on the qualifying condition.
time: Each additional 30 minutes of clinical staff time
performer: Clinical staff under the billing practitioner's direction
frequency: Add-on to 99426; up to twice per month
requirements: 99426 supported for the same patient and month
Time log showing staff minutes in 30-minute blocks beyond the first 30
Care plan and consent already on file
pitfalls: Reporting a block that was only partly completed

faqs.question: How many times can 99427 be billed per month?
faqs.answer: Up to twice per month with 99426. Always check the current fee schedule for changes.

faqs.question: Can 99427 be billed without 99426?
faqs.answer: No. It is an add-on and requires 99426 for the same patient and month.
